transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I came in because I can’t keep my words in a straight line anymore. Like, I’ll start talking about something from my overnight shift, and then suddenly I’m talking about soccer, or paint colors, or patient charts, and I can tell people are getting lost. It’s been really hard to explain myself.
Are these difficulties with keeping your thoughts in order causing you a lot of distress or problems in your daily life?

Yes. It’s causing real problems. At work I’ve had to ask coworkers to double-check my rounds and my charting because I don’t trust that I’m keeping things straight. At home, I’m behind on bills, I haven’t been answering friends, and my apartment is a mess.

It got bad enough that employee health sent me for an emergency evaluation after I told them I’d been thinking about suicide.
Have you been experiencing any thoughts or beliefs that seem unreal or detached from reality?

Yeah… I think so. I’m pretty sure my supervisors have been changing my shifts on purpose, and watching me through the unit cameras to see if I’m unsafe. People keep telling me it’s just staffing shortages, but it doesn’t feel like that to me. It feels directed at me.
Have you been hearing or seeing things that other people can't?
I’m not sure. I don’t think I’ve been seeing things, like, clearly. And I haven’t noticed voices talking to me or anything like that. At least not that I can say for sure.
Can you tell me more about what you mean by not being able to keep your words in a straight line?

I mean when I start talking, I can’t keep the topic together. Like I’ll try to explain something simple from an overnight shift, and then somehow I’m talking about soccer, then paint colors, then patient charts, and I don’t even realize I’ve jumped around until I see people looking confused.

It’s like the words come out, but they don’t stay in order.
Do you feel like your thoughts are racing, or is it more that you're having trouble organizing them?

It’s more that I can’t organize them. They don’t feel fast exactly… it’s like I start explaining one thing, like something from an overnight shift, and then I’m suddenly talking about soccer or paint colors or charts, and I can tell people aren’t following me. I just can’t keep the words in a straight line.
Have you experienced any periods where you felt unusually energetic, happy, or irritable, even if it was just for a short time?
I don’t think so. I mean, I get irritated sometimes, but not like a period where I’m suddenly full of energy or really happy or anything. I haven’t noticed that.
Have you ever had a period where you felt like you didn't need to sleep as much as you normally do?
No, I don’t think so. I mean, I have nights where I don’t sleep great, but I don’t feel like I need less sleep or have extra energy from it.
Do you still believe your supervisors are changing your shifts on purpose and watching you?

Yes. I still think they’re doing it on purpose. Like, people keep saying it’s just staffing shortages or the schedule changes, but I’m sure my supervisors are moving my shifts around and watching me on the unit cameras to see if I’m unsafe. I can’t really shake that.
Have you ever had a period where you felt extremely elevated or irritable for several days or more?
No, not really. I’ve been irritable at times, but I can’t think of several days where I felt extremely elevated or unusually irritable like that.
Have you been feeling sad or empty most of the time lately?
Yeah. Most days I wake up already feeling really heavy and empty. And after my shifts, sometimes I just sit in my car and cry for a while before I can even drive home.
Do you still think your supervisors are watching you through the cameras for reasons that are specifically about you?
Yes. I think it is about me. I’m sure they’re changing my shifts and watching me through the unit cameras to see if I’m unsafe, even when everyone keeps saying it’s just staffing shortages.
Do you think your belief about your supervisors watching you is something that might not be true?

I mean... people keep saying it’s just staffing shortages, but I don’t really believe that. It feels too specific. I’m pretty sure they changed my shifts and they’re watching me on the unit cameras to see if I’m unsafe.
Do you think it's possible that your belief about your supervisors watching you is not based on real events?

I guess people keep telling me that, but no… I don’t really think it’s possible. I’m sure they changed my shifts and they’re watching me through the cameras to see if I’m unsafe. It doesn’t feel like just staffing shortages to me.
Do you think your belief about your supervisors watching you could be a mistaken idea that is not based in reality?

No, I don’t think it’s mistaken. I know people keep saying it’s just staffing shortages, but it doesn’t feel random to me. I’m sure they changed my shifts and they’re watching me through the unit cameras because they think I’m unsafe.
Do you think your belief about your supervisors watching you is something that you might be able to change your mind about if you found out more information?

I don’t think more information would really change it. I mean, unless they showed me something that proved it wasn’t happening, but even then… I’m pretty sure they changed my shifts on purpose and they’re watching me on the cameras to see if I’m unsafe. It doesn’t feel like just a staffing thing.
Do you think your belief about your supervisors watching you is something that could be proven or disproven?

I mean… I think it could be proven if they showed the real reasons for the shift changes or the camera records, maybe. But I don’t think it would be disproven easily. I’m still sure they changed my shifts on purpose and watch me through the unit cameras because they think I’m unsafe, even if other people say it’s just staffing shortages.
Do you think there's any possibility that your thoughts about your supervisors watching you might be a break from reality?

No… I don’t really think it’s a break from reality. I know how it sounds, but I’m still sure they changed my shifts on purpose and watch me through the unit cameras because they think I’m unsafe. People keep saying it’s just staffing, but that doesn’t feel true to me.
Do you think your belief about your supervisors watching you is a delusion?

No, I don’t think it’s a delusion. I know people keep saying it’s just staffing shortages, but I’m sure my supervisors changed my shifts on purpose and they’re watching me through the unit cameras to see if I’m unsafe.
Do you think there are other people who might be involved in your supervisors' plan to watch you?

Maybe. I mean, I mostly think it’s my supervisors, but other people on the unit could be part of it too, if they’re using the cameras or telling them what I’m doing. I don’t know exactly who, but I’m sure the shift changes weren’t just staffing shortages.
